findings: `formation.type` and `formation.text`: The entry classifies 難 as phonosemantic, but its two sentences do not explain how the proposed phonetic element associated with 堇 supplies a sound cue for 難. Add a cited comparison or state that the historical sound relation is unconfirmed; do not leave the type sounding established when the component account says it is disputed.

`learner.overview`: The proposed borrowing mechanism is essential to explaining why a bird-name graph came to mean “difficult,” but “reuse ... depends on sound similarity” does not say that the graph was reused to write a separate word because the words were thought to sound alike. State that mechanism plainly and retain the caveat that the bird-name pronunciation is unrecovered.

`learner.components[1].text`: “堇 is analyzed as a sound component” omits the material uncertainty and gives no help with the non-obvious sound comparison. Explain briefly that the historical role is disputed and that the current readings 堇 jǐn and 難 nán are not an obvious match; the displayed sound pair already supplies those readings.
